headline: Indonesia Raises Authorized Capital of PT DSI to Rp4 Trillion
summary: Indonesia's State-Owned Enterprises Regulatory Agency increased the authorized capital of PT DSI to Rp4 trillion.
why: State-owned enterprise capital adjustments affect corporate expansion capacity and government investment allocations in Indonesia.

impacts.name: Indonesia
impacts.why: Capital increases enhance state-owned corporate borrowing and operational capacity.
